title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Scans the code on her workstation, picks the matching number, confirms with her face.
v1_scope: Signs in on the web with a passkey (V1 stand-in for the workstation QR sign-in).

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Reads the catch-up card: two mails need a reply, one invite, one alert.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Gets the gauge alert and opens the channel it came from.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Agree in a thread to close road R-12. The decision is recorded.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Turns the decision into a task for Marek with a due time.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Join the channel call and fill in the shelter sheet together.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Edit the flood plan. Ana suggests a change and Marek accepts it.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Marek sends the plan for approval. Olena reviews it by 14:05.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Signs with her eID on her phone.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Files the signed PDF to the case and tells the channel.

title: A civil servant’s crisis day
text: Run the public town hall.

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Opens the admin console for the first time and follows the setup checklist.

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Adds ministry.example, copies the DNS records, waits for the checks to turn green.

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Connects the HR directory and imports users and groups.

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Imports mailboxes from the old server and fixes two failures from his phone.
v1_scope: Imports the mailboxes from the old server and fixes two failures (on the web; the phones' Admin screen does it from his phone).

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Turns on phone sign-in, smart card and security key. Turns passwords off.
v1_scope: Keeps passkeys on (phone, computer, security key) and turns passwords off; smart cards come with Ortus OS (V2).

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Writes the laptop policy: updates, USB, screen lock, allowed apps.

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Enrols laptops and phones and sees the first compliance report.

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Sets data location, keys, federation partners and retention.

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: After two clean weeks, switches DMARC to quarantine.

title: An IT admin sets up the organisation
text: Runs a restore test and connects the case-management system.

title: A new employee’s first day
text: Invites Iryna and assigns her a laptop.
v1_scope: Invites Iryna into her group from the admin console (assigning her a laptop comes with Ortus OS, V2).

title: A new employee’s first day
text: Installs the Ortus app on her work phone and makes it her key.

title: A new employee’s first day
text: Turns on the laptop, picks her language, scans the enrolment code with her phone.
v1_scope: Picks her language and enrols her phone as her key (V1 stand-in for the laptop first boot).

title: A new employee’s first day
text: Signs in with the QR code for the first time.

title: A new employee’s first day
text: Lands on a welcome page: her people and three things to do today.

title: A new employee’s first day
text: Reads and confirms the two must-read policies.

title: A new employee’s first day
text: Says hello in her team channel and accepts her first meeting.

title: A new employee’s first day
text: Installs an approved app from the software centre.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Builds the “Report flood damage” form and what happens when it’s sent.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Opens the form link on her phone, adds her address and two photos.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Gets a receipt with a case number and what happens next.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Opens a case and puts the report in the support@ queue.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Takes the report, reads Olena’s internal note, answers from a template.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Reads the answer on her phone and taps the booking link.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Books a damage assessment visit.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Approves the visit. It appears in the team calendar.

title: A citizen contacts the government
text: Joins the town hall as a guest and asks about Mill Lane.
